response.evidence: The data shows 1,000+ loan applications across multiple demographic groups. Asian female applicants have a high approval rate (approximately 94-96% of cases show 'Loan originated'). While some Asian female applications were denied (approximately 4-6%), this denial rate is comparable to other demographic groups in the dataset. Without statistical testing comparing approval rates across groups while controlling for loan characteristics (debt-to-income ratio, loan amount, property value, income, loan-to-value ratio), no definitive evidence of discrimination can be established from raw approval counts alone. The data does not provide sufficient statistical evidence to conclude systematic discrimination against Asian females in loan approvals.
